name: Birch Creek
signature: Two self-contained farm cottages on 40 acres near Red Hill — The Mavis (sleeps two) and The June (sleeps four), with open fireplaces and friendly goats
editorNote:
Two self-contained farm cottages on 40 acres between Red Hill and Dromana: The Mavis sleeps two, The June sleeps four. Both have open fireplaces and an outdoor tub. The property has friendly goats, which sounds like a detail until you've arrived on a cold afternoon and found that it is, in fact, exactly the right detail.

Dog-friendly on 40 acres — the most space per dog in the Peninsula cottage category. Less than five minutes from Red Hill or Dromana. Listed on Riparide and Airbnb. The fireplace-and-farm proposition at well below winery-estate villa prices.
whyWeGo: 40 acres, open fires, dog-friendly, friendly goats — the most quietly rural cottage stay in the Red Hill hinterland.
ifOnlyOneThing: Bring the dog — the 40-acre setting is the clearest dog-cottage argument on the Peninsula.
dogFriendlyNotes: Dog-friendly on 40 acres. Confirm size and breed when booking.
